name: Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate
notes:
The Domestic Abuse Victim Advocate provides confidential services to victims of domestic abuse, 24 hours a day / 7 days a week. In addition to providing crisis support, the DAVA can:
•	Help safety plan
•	Explain reporting options *
•	Provide accompaniment to legal/medical appointments
•	Explain Early Return of Dependent (ERD) process
•	Help connect victims with supportive resources
If you or someone you know has experienced domestic violence, you are not alone. Please contact us.
*Restricted Report: Adult victim of abuse, when reporting an incident, requests the report not be disclosed. The victim can receive medical treatment and Family Advocacy services without command or law enforcement notification. Must request RESTRICTED. Unrestricted Report: Made by anyone who suspects abuse or neglect. The victim/s and offender have full access to protective services of their command, law enforcement, and Family Advocacy, etc.
